title: My dreams
content: 1. Mall 2. Food court 3. Overflowing nasty bathrooms off the concourse. 4. The underground leading to the rickety elevators. 5. “Guarded” airport and the planes look messed up. 6. Inside the mall you see planters and water fountains. You can skate here. Just don’t go too far. 7. You can jump to the second floor to some cool shops.
